description: This file defines various Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) used in the backend API of an outage management and dispatch platform. It contains record types for locations, customers, crews, outages, jobs, status events, updates, and requests related to creating or updating these entities.

classes.name: CreateOutageRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating an outage, including location details and required fields.

classes.name: UpdateOutageStatusRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating the status of an outage.

classes.name: AddOutageNoteRequest
classes.description: DTO for adding notes to an outage.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a job linked to an outage.

classes.name: AssignJobRequest
classes.description: DTO for assigning a crew or user to a job.

classes.name: UpdateJobStatusRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating the status of a job.

classes.name: PagedResult
classes.description: Generic DTO for paginated result sets.
